Meaning: Twelve sequential same-source actual-device Classic ordinary-input E1M1/intermission/E1M2 routes: three Pairs-ColorState-ColorState-Pairs ABBA cycles with bounded AsyncBatch output in both encoders. Independent CSV display-count/p99 checks match the analyzer and per-frame byte totals match completed-output accounting. Identical command streams and settings do not establish identical frame samples; byte-per-frame statistics include each observed image. Standard CPU/memory sampling omits unsampled startup/tails and is a lower bound on peaks. ETW display events are not optical distinct Doom frame identities. This one hardware, one style, one workload comparison cannot close the broader campaign/acoustic/physical-input/display/full-release gates.

ExactColorCheck.Meaning: Experimental foreground/background state compression. Independently parse the entire stream and compare every painted RGB pixel to its source palette; no unrecognized bytes or duplicate painting accepted. Odd dimensions, uneven partitions and offsets plus six real static views. Alternating-order 16-strip serial encoding, including UTF8 and memory-stream assembly; setup/rendering and preceding correctness checks excluded. All timed samples retained. No concurrent study workload, terminal output, audio, display or full-game performance claim.

AuditorCorrection.Reason: The first audit compared string representations of source-entry dictionaries, incorrectly treating JSON property order as identity. Sorting actual path/hash pairs confirms one identical host-source set across all twelve captures. No game/capture source drift; the corrected independent audit passes.

FailureInvestigation.Cycle1Position4: 34.641 reported active tics/sec despite all 1747 commands consumed. The final observed asynchronous write takes 741.5613 ms and final clock includes draining it. The failed rate is retained under the frozen measurement boundary; no shortened denominator is substituted.
FailureInvestigation.Cycle3Position3: 34.672 reported active tics/sec, p99 lateness 370.199 ms, maximum 440.081 ms. E1M2 mean slowest-worker raster is 18.976 ms; snapshot publication averages 9.021 ms, game update 6.787 ms, packet production 0.175 ms and observed output completion 15.031 ms. Audio backpressure is zero. Map load is 2.915 seconds. A 2896.868 ms observed completion for an intermission frame overlaps that load; completion timestamps are observations, so this alone does not prove a native-output stall of that duration. Scheduling/system/thermal cause is unestablished.
FailureInvestigation.Boundary: All global windows retain map-load and output-drain gaps. Endpoints and sampled image mixtures vary even with identical commands; output bytes per frame are observational rather than an identical-image compression ratio.
